scientific_integrity: A self-contained analytic proof is provided; finite tests are corroboration only. No claims of exhaustive literature certification, independent mathematical validation, or invented provenance.
scientific_limitations: The absolute error constant 1/2 is not asserted optimal; results concern the squared Hilbert–Schmidt norm, not individual singular values or other Schatten exponents. Critical expansion requires N >= 8L. Classical collision identities may have precursors not caught by indexed searches.
title: Uniform Bessel approximation and critical correction for finite Euler summability matrices
